subject: Request: invoice cadence & extended payment terms — StateEd District 12 (PO 2026-1783)
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@statedistrict12.edu>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stateprocure.gov>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: invoicing cadence & extended payment terms for StateEd District 12

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and the control plane features. Purchasing has a couple of standard constraints I wanted to flag before we move forward with the PO.

1) State policy requires quarterly invoicing for software-as-a-service agreements over $50k unless an exception is granted.
2) The state pays on Net-90 after receipt of invoice and verification against the PO.

We have a signed PO (PO_2026-1783.pdf attached) but the finance office will not be able to move faster than their Net-90 policy. To keep things moving on your side, would Redwood consider:
- Quarterly invoicing (one invoice per quarter) instead of monthly cycles, and
- Net-90 payment terms for the life of the first-year contract

We understand this is outside typical commercial terms. If helpful, we can add a clause for timely payment escalation to a state fiscal contact and are open to an SLA credit if an urgent operational issue arises during the PO clearance period.

Let me know what approvals you need and we can escalate internally on our end as well.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
StateEd District 12
Attachments: PO_2026-1783.pdf


From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Marissa / Ben — forwarding request from StateEd (PO attached). Overview below:

- Customer: StateEd District 12 (public K-12 district)
- ARR (first year): ~$310k annual commitment, three-year preferred agreement potential
- Ask: quarterly invoicing + Net-90 payment terms (state mandate)
- Attachments: PO_2026-1783.pdf, their standard terms referenced in the PO

We typically push for Net-30 and monthly invoicing. This is a strategic reference sale into the education vertical. Marissa, you know the account — would prefer to be flexible if the margin hit is manageable. Ben, can you run the quick risk/controls checklist and advise what mitigations (escrow, holdback, milestone invoicing) we'd require to accept Net-90/quarterly?

If we need executive sign-off I can prepare a short memo. Would like to avoid delaying kickoff.

Thanks,
Olga
Strategic Accounts — Public Sector

Thanks for the context — quick finance take after reviewing the PO and the redline we discussed offline.

Risks:
- Net-90 increases DSO and cash exposure materially; $310k ARR means ~ $77k per quarter unpaid for 90 days.
- Quarterly invoices reduce our ability to reconcile usage monthly; potential mismatch if overage billing is needed.

Mitigations we can accept (one or combo):
1) Quarterly invoicing OK if invoices are issued at quarter start for the upcoming quarter (so payment window starts earlier relative to consumption) and the PO is irrevocable.
2) Escrow/holdback: recommend a 10–15% holdback retained until final payment on each annual cycle to mitigate non-payment.
3) Milestone split: invoice 50% at kickoff (against PO), 50% quarterly — requires PO to allow partial invoicing.
4) Credit approval: require AP/cash credit sign-off from Finance (I can provision a one-time credit line for StateEd through Q4 if legal/exec approve).

Operational asks: we need the amendment drafted (amendment-invoice-cadence-draft.pdf attached) that both Legal and the customer sign; it should reference the PO number and state that quarterly invoices supersede default monthly billing for the term.

Policy note: Net-90 is outside standard procurement policy; this needs Exec-level approval (Revenue Ops + CFO). If approved, Finance will attach the credit memo and a conditional clause for SLA credits tied to late payment on critical incidents.

Suggested path: Marissa files an exec approval request w/ deal economics and proposed mitigations; I'll summarize capex/cash exposure. If leadership signs off, Finance can provision conditional credit for the first year to get the customer live.

-Ben
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: amendment-invoice-cadence-draft.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Team — I support moving forward with a conditional concession for this one. Key points for the exec memo:

- Strategic value: opens statewide procurement reference for K-12 (high expansion upside).
- Economics: first year ARR $310k; margin impact estimated ~6% if we do 10% holdback.
- Ask: Approve Net-90 + quarterly invoices for year 1 only, contingent on: PO receipt, signed amendment, and Finance-provided credit line.

I'll draft the approval memo and include the expansion forecast and recommended expiry of concession at 12 months. Ben — Please include the cash exposure numbers and suggested holdback in the memo. Olga — can you confirm customer will sign the amendment and confirm PO irrevocability? I'll escalate to Jonas for final sign-off once draft is ready.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Approval: conditional Net-90 & quarterly invoicing — StateEd District 12 (RDW-5421)

Olga/Marissa/Ben — after reviewing the memo and finance notes, I approve a conditional exception for this account with the following non-negotiable conditions:

1) The customer must provide an irrevocable PO referencing PO_2026-1783 before any services are provisioned.
2) We will accept quarterly invoicing for the first 12 months only. Quarterly invoices must be issued at the start of each quarter (pre-pay window opens on invoice date).
3) Net-90 accepted for year 1, contingent on Finance issuing a one-time conditional credit line; Ben to record credit terms and monitoring plan.
4) 10% holdback retained on each invoice, released after annual reconciliation or upon receipt of guaranteed payment per PO.
5) Legal to finalize and sign the amendment documenting cadence and payment terms before provisioning.

Olga — please confirm receipt of the signed amendment and PO to myself and Ben. Laura — thanks for working with us on the PO; once those documents are in place we will schedule the onboarding kickoff.

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Operations
